attempts.summary: On node1 (AlmaLinux 9), built a local RPM repository at /srv/local-repo from packages pre-downloaded while the network was up (tree-1.8.0-10.el9.x86_64.rpm + createrepo_c metadata), registered it via /etc/yum.repos.d/local-file.repo (file:// baseurl, gpgcheck=0). Simulated the usual remote repos being unreachable by disabling all almalinux-*.repo files and adding iptables REJECT rules on tcp/80 and tcp/443, confirmed via curl and dnf that remotes were unreachable, then installed `tree` successfully using only the local-file repo. Reverted the firewall rules and re-enabled the original remote repos, verified remote reachability restored. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline (513c865e...), rebooted node1 via `shutdown -r now` (ack returned before disconnect), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id (bcd7d486...), and verified post-restart that tree remained installed, local repo storage/metadata were intact, remote repos were enabled/reachable again, and no leftover firewall rules remained.
